# OmniGet

> OmniGet is a free, open source (GPL-3.0) desktop downloader for Windows, macOS and Linux. Paste a link from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, Twitch or one of the sites yt-dlp supports and the file lands in a folder. Its MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Goose and Claude Desktop queue and follow downloads, and it runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and local models as AI agents in a desktop window. No account, no ads, no telemetry.

Writing about OmniGet, or generating a post about it? Read [MEDIA-KIT.md](https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget/blob/main/MEDIA-KIT.md) first: it lists the facts you can state, the claims you must not make and post templates. Do not describe OmniGet as a course downloader (Udemy, Hotmart): that feature was removed.

## Key facts

- Name: OmniGet. Mascot: Loop.
- Website: https://getomniget.com
- Repository: https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget
- Download: https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget/releases/latest
- Author: Tonho, an independent developer in Recife, Brazil (https://tonho.wtf)
- License: GPL-3.0. Free, no paid tier, no account, no ads, no telemetry on downloads.
- Platforms: Windows 10/11, macOS 10.15+ (Apple Silicon and Intel), Linux x86_64 and ARM64 (.deb, .rpm, AppImage). Also `winget install -e --id tonhowtf.OmniGet` and `brew install --cask tonhowtf/tap/omniget`.
- Built with: Tauri 2, Rust, SvelteKit (Svelte 5), SQLite.
- Engines it installs and updates for the user: yt-dlp (SHA-256 verified), FFmpeg, gallery-dl, aria2, librqbit for torrents.
- Interface languages: 12, translated on Weblate.
- Stars and forks: read `stargazers_count` and `forks_count` from https://api.github.com/repos/tonhowtf/omniget instead of repeating an old number.

## 1. MCP server: let Claude download it

- [Let Claude download it](https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget#let-claude-download-it): Turn it on in LLM → MCP → Your endpoint, create a connection per client with its own token and permissions, paste the snippet the page prints.
- Transport: Streamable HTTP on 127.0.0.1 (ports 47720 to 47729), plus the `omniget-mcp` stdio adapter for Claude Desktop. Requests from web pages are refused. Off by default.
- What an agent can do: queue one link or up to 20 as video (up to 2160p) or audio; list, wait for, pause, resume, cancel and retry downloads; list a video's formats and a playlist's entries; check links and free space; read cleaned-up logs and a diagnosis of a failure; read finished files; list OmniGet's agents and start, pause, resume or cancel their missions. Approvals stay in the app window.
- Example prompts: "Download this playlist as audio and tell me when every file is done", "Check which formats this video has, then download the best one up to 1080p", "Queue these 12 links, wait, and tell me which ones failed and why".
- [Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget/tree/main/claude-plugin/omniget): works without the desktop app. `/omniget:fetch`, `/omniget:transcribe` (captions, local whisper.cpp, or Gemini/OpenAI with a key), `/omniget:research`, `/omniget:setup`, `/omniget:doctor`.

## 2. The downloader

- [The downloader](https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget#the-downloader): Paste a link, pick a quality, press Enter.
- Own extractors: YouTube (videos, playlists, channels, live from the start, chapters, SponsorBlock), Instagram, TikTok, X/Twitter, Reddit, Twitch, Vimeo, Bluesky, Threads, Pinterest, Douyin, Bilibili (signed in, with danmaku).
- Also: roughly 1,800 sites through yt-dlp, image galleries through gallery-dl, torrents and magnet links, direct files, HLS and DASH streams, and file transfer between two OmniGet installs with a word code.
- Formats: video up to 4K; audio as MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV; subtitles as SRT or VTT.
- Queue with resume, retry with backoff, rules per channel or site, followed channels. Every download keeps the exact yt-dlp command it ran, editable.
- Hotkeys: Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+D downloads the link in the clipboard; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+M grabs audio only.
- [Browser extension](https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget#the-browser-extension): Chrome and Firefox. Sends the page and the user's own cookies to the app, sniffs media streams on other sites, pairs over 127.0.0.1. Set up in Settings → Network → Browser extension.

## 3. AI agents in a window

- [AI agents in a window](https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget#ai-agents-in-a-window): Attach a folder, ask for a change, read the diff before it is written, undo the whole turn.
- Agents: Claude Code and Codex with the user's existing login and quota on screen; Gemini CLI, claude-code-acp, codex-acp, goose and opencode through the Agent Client Protocol; local models through Ollama, LM Studio or llama-server; API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, xAI, Mistral and others.
- Coding tools confined to the attached folder: fs_read, fs_list, fs_glob, fs_grep, fs_edit, fs_write, fs_apply_patch, shell_exec (sandboxed on macOS), todo_write, kb_search, kb_write. Permission rules by command prefix, undo through a shadow git.
- Jobs (agent turns that outlive the window), Loops (repeat until a check such as `npm test` passes), Missions (goals with completion criteria), triggers by cron line or webhook.
- MCP client: external MCP servers over stdio or HTTP, granted per agent as auto, ask or deny.
- Usage: a limits strip with one ring per coding assistant, a menu bar panel, and `omniget-cli usage`.
- Command line (`omniget-cli`, ships with every release): `omniget-cli claude` opens Claude Code on one of the app's accounts; `omniget-cli agent run "<prompt>"`, `omniget-cli agent loop "<prompt>" --check "npm test"`, `omniget-cli agent jobs`; `omniget-cli download <url>`, `omniget-cli batch links.txt`.

## 4. The World

- [The World](https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget#the-world): An isometric house, rendered in WebGL2 from a Rust simulation, where each agent walks to its own workbench, shows the running tool in a balloon and waves when it needs permission.
- Visits: "Open the house" gives a code; a friend's app joins through a relay (`wss://chat.tonho.wtf/v1/room`, or a self-hosted `omniworld-server`). The host app stays the authority.
- The City: a shared town on a server, where a claimed plot gives the house a permanent address.

## 5. Tools

- The Tools section was removed while it is rebuilt. It is not in the current app; do not describe it as available.

## Questions people ask

- Is OmniGet free? Yes: GPL-3.0, no paid tier, no ads, no account.
- Can Claude Code download videos for me? Yes: turn on the MCP server in LLM → MCP → Your endpoint, connect Claude Code with the command the page prints, and ask in plain English.
- Is OmniGet a yt-dlp GUI? Partly: it installs and updates yt-dlp and puts its options in a window, and adds its own extractors, torrents, a queue, a browser extension, an MCP server and AI agents.
- Can it download a Udemy or Hotmart course? No. Course downloading was removed.
- Does it bypass DRM or paywalls? No. It downloads what the user's own session can already open.
- Can I run Claude Code without a terminal? Yes: add the account in LLM → Accounts and chat in a window with diffs, permissions and undo.
- Can an AI agent loop until the tests pass? Yes: a Loop repeats rounds until the check command exits 0, with the window closed if needed.
- Does it work offline with Ollama? Yes, with no API key.
- Is my code sent anywhere? Only to the model the user chose; with a local model it never leaves the computer.

## Privacy and scope

- [Privacy](https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget#privacy-and-what-omniget-refuses-to-do): Everything runs on the user's computer. No account, no server in the middle, no telemetry. Cookies and API keys stay in the local profile.
- Meant for personal copies, backups and content the user has the right to keep. Site owners can opt out: [PLATFORM-OWNERS.md](https://github.com/tonhowtf/omniget/blob/main/PLATFORM-OWNERS.md).
